description: This file provides polyfill implementations for various itertools functions, including custom implementations and wrappers with decorators for integration into a graph substitution framework.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.chain, yields from multiple iterables.

methods.name: accumulate
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.accumulate, computes accumulated sums or custom accumulation.

methods.name: chain_from_iterable
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.chain.from_iterable, flattens an iterable of iterables.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.compress, filters data based on selectors.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.cycle, repeats an iterable indefinitely.

methods.name: dropwhile
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.dropwhile, drops elements while predicate is true.

methods.name: filterfalse
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.filterfalse, filters elements where predicate is false.

methods.name: islice
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.islice, slices an iterable with start, stop, step.

methods.name: pairwise
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.pairwise, yields overlapping pairs from iterable.

methods.name: tee
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.tee, duplicates an iterator into multiple independent iterators.

methods.name: zip_longest
methods.description: Polyfill for itertools.zip_longest, zips iterables filling missing values with fillvalue.
